name: Agent hooks inject unread messages and MCP ack settles them
trigger: Send two unread messages to a synthetic seat, invoke Claude UserPromptSubmit and Codex Stop hooks, then read and ack them through fake MCP inbox calls.
observe: Claude output nests additionalContext under hookSpecificOutput and includes only addressed mail
repeated delivery of the same session bundle is suppressed and Stop blocks once
MCP inbox observes both messages, per-ID ack removes one, and cross-seat ack is refused
expected: hook delivery and MCP inbox acknowledgement agree on the same seat-scoped unread set with no external process or network calls
